title: Insulin (blood)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Insulin is a hormone made by the pancreas that helps move blood glucose (blood sugar) into cells for energy. An insulin in blood test measures how much insulin is in the blood.
context: Results are read together with a blood glucose test, since insulin and glucose normally rise and fall together. You will usually fast for 8 to 12 hours, and biotin supplements can affect the result.
aboveRange: With normal or slightly high glucose, can be associated with insulin resistance
With low glucose, may relate to a pancreatic tumor (insulinoma), Cushing's syndrome, or taking too much insulin
belowRange: With high glucose, may mean the pancreas is not making enough insulin, as in type 1 diabetes or pancreatitis
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
